invariants.description: On activation of the emergency shutdown system (ESD), ALL safety-critical equipment (pumps, compressors, feed valves) SHALL be placed in safe state. No critical equipment may remain running after ESD activation.

z3_template.omission_check: No rule found to stop critical equipment {equipment} on ESD activation

invariants.description: ESD activation shall be logged and an alarm shall be raised in the control system. A silent ESD (no alarm) is a specification defect.

z3_template.omission_check: No alarm rule for ESD activation in the specification

invariants.description: ESD shall only be reset by an authorised manual action. Automatic ESD reset without operator confirmation is a specification defect.

z3_template.omission_check: Specification permits automatic ESD reset without operator authorisation

invariants.description: ESD activation path must be independent of the basic process control system (BPCS). No single common-cause failure should be able to prevent both the ESD and process control from responding.

z3_template.omission_check: ESD and BPCS share the same PLC — independence requirement of IEC 61511 Cl. 10.3 may be violated
